integrity: Analytical argument for fixed shapes and the uniform two-parameter crossover; standalone exact-rational finite checks supplement rather than establish the asymptotic proof.
scientific_limitations: The O_R(log N) remainder is uniform for fixed bounded window parameters but its constant is not optimized.
Absolute bibliographic priority is not independently certified.
The theorem concerns finite Hilbert–Schmidt energy, not Schatten-class membership of an infinite operator.
title: Critical-window and fixed-parameter Hilbert–Schmidt laws for beta-Hausdorff matrices
